name: Pub Crawl with VIP Club Entry
description: The classic way to experience Porto's legendary nightlife. Meet new people, enjoy drinks at several bars, and end the night with VIP entry to a top club.
longDescription:
This Pub Crawl with VIP Club Entry offers a structured way to explore Porto's evening entertainment scene. Organized by a local nightlife promoter, the event is designed to introduce participants to a selection of bars and a prominent nightclub in the city center, facilitating social interaction among attendees. It serves as an organized social outing for those looking to engage with Porto's after-dark offerings.

Participants can expect an evening of bar hopping, moving between multiple establishments, with opportunities to purchase drinks at each location. The event culminates in guaranteed entry to a popular club, bypassing general queues. The atmosphere is generally social and energetic, catering to individuals interested in meeting new people while exploring different venues. The event is conducted in English.

Tickets are required for participation. The meeting point is in the City Center, a location easily accessible by metro, bus, and on foot from many central accommodations. Specific accessibility information is not available.
